response:
Based on my analysis, here is the squash commit message describing the final state of the feature.

feat(CC-0117): project admin password per ControlPlane

Replace the static, cluster-wide admin-password ExternalSecret with a
per-ControlPlane secret the c5c3 operator projects from OpenBao, so two
ControlPlanes never collide on the shared backend and the admin
credential follows the ControlPlane lifecycle.

- Add an AdminPassword sub-reconciler that, in managed mode
  (Database.ClusterRef set), create-or-updates a per-ControlPlane,
  OpenBao-backed ExternalSecret in the child namespace, owner-referenced
  to the ControlPlane for garbage collection and with ESO owning the
  materialised Secret (CreationPolicy Owner)
- Run AdminPassword before the Keystone sub-reconciler so the projected
  Keystone child's bootstrap reference resolves once the keystone
  operator's SecretsReady gate evaluates it
- Skip projection in brownfield mode (Database.ClusterRef nil): the user
  supplies the admin-password Secret out-of-band, so AdminPasswordReady
  is reported True immediately and OpenBao is never referenced
- Add the AdminPasswordReady status condition, register it in
  subConditionTypes and the sub-reconciler condition-type map for metrics
  labels, and give it a dedicated requeue interval while ESO syncs
- Derive a deterministic, collision-free Secret name
  ({keystoneName}-admin-credentials) and a keystone-name-scoped OpenBao
  key (bootstrap/{namespace}/{keystone}/admin) that matches the seeder
  and the keystone operator's Model B rotation PushSecret
- Introduce effectiveAdminPasswordSecretRef so every consumer reads one
  source of truth: the operator-owned per-CP Secret in managed mode, the
  user-supplied spec ref in brownfield mode, returned by value so spec is
  never mutated
- Point the projected Keystone bootstrap ref, the K-ORC clouds.yaml
  cleartext read, and the Secret-name field indexer at the effective ref
- Remove the static keystone-admin, mariadb-root-password, and orphaned
  orc-system k-orc-clouds-yaml ExternalSecrets; deploy/eso now ships only
  the ClusterSecretStore and the production stack projects all secrets
  per ControlPlane
- Add kind-only ExternalSecret shims for keystone-admin and
  mariadb-root-password so standalone Quick Start and e2e/chaos flows
  keep working off the default identity
- Update the OpenBao eso-control-plane and eso-management policies to
  document that the projected read path is already covered by the
  existing bootstrap read grant, requiring no widening
- Update the k-orc HelmRelease, namespace declarations, bootstrap seed
  script, and deploy-infra notes to reflect operator projection and the
  removed static manifests
- Add unit tests for the AdminPassword sub-reconciler (managed
  projection, brownfield skip, wait/condition handling), an integration
  test wiring the admin-password ExternalSecret, a managed-mode field
  indexer test, and updated credential-invariant and Keystone/K-ORC
  tests to assert the operator-owned effective Secret
- Add a Chainsaw e2e test asserting per-ControlPlane admin-password
  scoping with a presence guard, and refresh the quick-start, CRD,
  reconciler, infrastructure, and OpenBao-bootstrap reference docs
